issues: Page numbers are the PDF page index (the <<<PAGE n>>> marker value); the book's printed page numbers (from the Contents) are NOT used.

The Contents (PDF pages 6-10) maps to PDF pages via a roughly constant printed->PDF offset of +21 for chapter start pages, but individual section headings drift by up to ~9 pages, so every section page was verified directly against the body text rather than derived from the Contents.

Sections enumerate the first-level headings per chapter only; deeper sub-subsections (e.g. individual antipsychotic monographs inside 'ANTIPSYCHOTIC DRUGS', or the clozapine adverse-effect sub-topics) are not listed.

Some section headings collide with ordinary mentions in the text (e.g. 'Carbamazepine' at 275 vs the real section at 285, 'Bipolar depression' at 269 vs 309, 'BPSD' at 629 vs 665, 'Breastfeeding' at 702 vs 723). These were disambiguated using TOC order and page running-headers.
Front matter granularity: page 1 is blank; 'Title Page' spans 2-4; Preface 12-13; Acknowledgments 14; 'Notes on using the guidelines' 15-16; 'List of abbreviations' 17-21.
The four 'Part' divider pages (22, 558, 776, 852) and the blank pages that follow them are recorded in unattributedPages.
Back matter (Index, PDF pages 964-977, and the Wiley End User License Agreement, page 978) is not representable by the frontMatter/chapters shape and is recorded in unattributedPages.
Several heading lines in the extraction carry trailing reference superscripts (e.g. 'Physical monitoring for people with bipolar disorder1,2'); these have been stripped from titles.
